lines.text: Jake reached a cold creek, high after the rain.
He stepped in with his pack buckled tight.
One slip, and his spare layers got soaked.
Here's the fix. Cross at a wide, slow, shallow spot.
Unclip the hip belt so you can drop the pack if you fall.
Face upstream and use a pole.
If the water is fast or above your knees, turn back.
Keep dry layers in a dry bag.
Save this before your next fall hike.
